title: Joining Celestin's band in 1926
summary: Straight out of high school she was recommended as pianist and auditioned on orchestrations such as Alabama Bound. Her mother let her go.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Do you remember, when did you join Papa Subtame Band?
I joined his band in September 1926. Right out of high school.
Did they, I mean, how did they get in touch with you?
One of my friends over here heard that they wanted a pianist. And he recommended me. And they came over and interviewed me. And that's where it started.
What did, what, when you say that, who was it? Papa Subtame by himself? Papa Subtame and Paul Vaughn.
I mean, what did they ask you?

Well, they found, they heard that I could read very well and was a good musician. Although I had never been away from home because I was too young to go away. And they came over and brought some orchestrations of which I had never seen, because I had only played sheet music. They brought some orchestrations and asked me to play them, and I played them right off. One of them I can remember as being Alabama Bound. That's the only one of which I can remember. And they asked my mother if I could join them. And she said, well, she's young, she's never been away from home, but I feel that she can take care of herself. And having a lot of relatives in New Orleans, she said, yes. So that's how I joined them.
What, were you in your teens then? Yeah. What, so you had to play for them. I mean, they didn't just talk to you. You actually had to play the piano for them.
Yes, I had to show them what I could do.
